run_mujoco_dr_visualization: run the MuJoCo direct replay viewer to visualize robot hand trajectories from dataset files
run_simulation_with_ctrl_modes: run the MuJoCo simulation with retarget, noise, rect, or debug control modes for robot hand replay
run_simulation_with_video_recording: run the MuJoCo direct replay viewer with video recording enabled to save MP4 output
run_simulation_with_external_forces: run the MuJoCo simulation with external force applied to objects via PD position control
run_simulation_headless: run the MuJoCo direct replay viewer in headless mode without launching the GUI window
